classes.name: Runestones
classes.description: A palm-sized stone carved with one glowing rune. It works while you carry it in a hand, a pouch or on a cord.

condition.name: Rune-Bound
condition.summary: Level 3 or more: faint runes glow on your skin, and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in darkness.

items.name: Ward
items.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

items.name: Lore
items.text: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

items.name: Clarity
items.text: You gain proficiency in the Insight skill.

items.name: Vigor
items.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 5.

items.name: Fortune
items.text: Once per Long Rest, you can reroll a D20 Test. You must use the new roll.

items.name: Endurance
items.text: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

items.name: Calm
items.text: You have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws to resist the Charmed condition.

items.name: Blessing
items.text: Once per Long Rest, you can cast *Bless* without a spell slot. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you first carry the stone).

items.name: Night Eye
items.text: While you stand in darkness, you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet, or the range of your Darkvision increases by 30 feet.

items.name: Flame Ward
items.text: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

items.name: Echo
items.text: The stone hums softly whenever a creature within 10 feet of you tells a deliberate lie. The DM decides what you notice.

items.name: Lantern of Embers
items.text:
While attuned to the lantern, you know one Wizard cantrip of your choice; Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

As a Bonus Action you can make the flame burn blue or return it to orange. While it burns blue, you have Resistance to Cold damage.
